speaker.travelLead: Book hotel and shuttle once the team has unlocked it for you.
speaker.arrivalBody:
The Congress Center Hamburg sits at Dammtor, right in the city.
By train: long-distance services stop at Hamburg Dammtor, a five-minute walk away.
By car: there is a car park at the CCH, the approach is signposted. Allow extra time at rush hour.
On site: the speaker counter in the foyer is your first stop.

partnerEventApp.title: Event app
partnerEventApp.lead: Your presence in the app, and how you get to your leads.
partnerEventApp.appBody: Everything on site runs there: your exhibitor profile, your team, the participant list and lead scanning. You sign in with the email address your ticket is personalised to. The app opens to participants in mid-March — your profile should be ready by then.
partnerEventApp.wikiHint: More in the wiki under Event app
partnerEventApp.stepsTitle: What to do in the app
partnerEventApp.videoTitle: How to set up your presence

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.body: Go to the exhibitor area of the app and fill in your profile completely. Add links to your careers page and social channels, a header image and further information.

steps.title: Add your team
steps.body: Best through the partner portal under “Contacts”. You can also add team members directly in the app — but only once they have personalised a ticket to their email address.

steps.title: Complete your colleagues’ profiles
steps.body: Ideally every team member’s profile is filled in properly, so participants can see straight away who they are talking to.

steps.title: Turn on contact sharing
steps.body: Important: in each profile, make sure contacts are shared with the team. Otherwise you will not be able to access your leads afterwards. The wiki explains how.

steps.title: Post open roles
steps.body: Under “Open roles” you can add positions. We recommend at most three, and ones that are appealing and representative. A traineeship or a project manager role speaks to a broad audience — very specific roles put people off at first.

steps.title: Find matching profiles
steps.body: The app goes live in mid-March. Under “Participants” you can then filter profiles by various criteria, among them field of study and work experience. Use it to identify suitable talent and reach out with a pointer to your presence. More tips are in the wiki under Event app.

partnerBooth.equipBody: Our all-inclusive booths come with a basic set-up. Extra items and upgrades are available in the exhibitor shop. And don't worry: if you forget something, almost everything can still be rented at the exhibitor kiosk during the FLS.

The wiki holds the exact print specifications — feel free to share them with your design team or an agency, everything relevant is in there. Use “Upload now” to upload the final file or replace it.
